description: Single-panel X-ray diffraction figure: three vertically offset diffractograms drawn as Intensity (a.u.) versus 2θ (deg.) over 20-110° with 10° major ticks. A top-right legend identifies the traces — black 15Al 550 °C × 1 h, red 17Al 575 °C × 1 h, blue 19Al 550 °C × 6 h — and a top-left symbol key assigns ♦ to α/D0₃, ♣ to α-Mn and ♠ to β-Mn. Every trace is dominated by an intense, strongly overlapping reflection cluster between roughly 50° and 56° 2θ, labelled ♦(411), ♠(310), ♦(220)D0₃ and ♣(110)α. Further labelled reflections sit near 43° (♠(110)), 57-60° (♣(332), ♠(422), ♣(510), ♠(521)), ~72-78° (♣(410), ♠(330), ♣(110)α, ♦(220)D0₃, ♠(420)) and ~90-101° (♣(444), ♣(510), ♣(721), ♠(620), ♣(521), ♠(521)); the leftmost ♦(400)/♣(221)-type indices belong to the same 50-56° cluster. The three patterns show the same reflection positions and similar relative intensities, with no resolvable peak shift or extra phase between the alloys. The panel therefore demonstrates that after the selected aging treatments all three alloys contain α/D0₃ together with both α-Mn and β-Mn, i.e. the two Mn-rich phases co-precipitated before the α matrix fully transformed to β-Mn.

observations.observation: The figure is a single XRD panel with 2θ (deg.) on the x-axis spanning 20 to 110 (10° major ticks) and Intensity (a.u.) on the y-axis; no numerical intensity scale is printed.
Three vertically offset traces are shown, labelled in the legend as 15Al 550 °C × 1 h (black), 17Al 575 °C × 1 h (red) and 19Al 550 °C × 6 h (blue).
The symbol key defines ♦ = α/D0₃, ♣ = α-Mn and ♠ = β-Mn, so every indexed reflection in the three patterns is assigned to one of these three phases.
The strongest feature in all three traces is a broad overlapping reflection cluster between about 50° and 56° 2θ, labelled ♦(411), ♠(310), ♦(220)D0₃ and ♣(110)α.
The lowest-angle labelled reflection is ♠ (110) of β-Mn near 43° 2θ, and the highest-angle indexed reflections lie near 100-101° (♣(521) and ♠(521)).
The labelled reflections of α-Mn (♣) and β-Mn (♠) occur at essentially the same 2θ positions in the black, red and blue traces, indicating the same phases are present in all three aged conditions.
The caption states the figure presents the XRD results for the 15Al, 17Al and 19Al alloys subjected to different aging treatments.

The citing text states that both α-Mn and β-Mn diffraction peaks were found in these patterns, indicating that α-Mn and β-Mn were coprecipitated during aging before the α matrix fully transformed to β-Mn.
The citing text states that the samples selected for the XRD tests were the 15Al alloy aged at 550 °C for 1 h, the 17Al alloy aged at 575 °C for 1 h and the 19Al alloy aged at 550 °C for 6 h.
The citing text states that β-Mn precipitation kinetics slow with increasing Al content (based on SE images), which is the motivation for choosing these three particular aging conditions for XRD.
Peak labels are printed vertically above each reflection; several indices in the 50-56° cluster and the 90-101° region overlap and cannot be individually resolved with certainty.

subfigures.description: One XRD pattern plot containing three vertically stacked, offset diffractograms (black 15Al 550 °C × 1 h; red 17Al 575 °C × 1 h; blue 19Al 550 °C × 6 h) of intensity (a.u.) vs 2θ (deg.) from 20 to 110°. Symbol key: ♦ α/D0₃, ♣ α-Mn, ♠ β-Mn. Labels include ♠(110) ~43°, an overlapping cluster ~50-56° marked ♦(411), ♠(310), ♦(220)D0₃, ♣(110)α, and many higher-angle indices up to ~101°.

unreadable_items: The densely overlapping index labels in the ~50-56° 2θ cluster (♦(411), ♠(310), ♦(220)D0₃, ♣(110)α, ♣(400), ♠(221)) cannot all be individually resolved with certainty
Distinguishing which of the closely spaced higher-angle indices (e.g. ♣(332)/♠(422), ♣(510)/♠(521), ♣(721)/♠(620)) is attached to which minor peak is partially ambiguous
